Commit: https://github.com/plone/plone.distribution/commit/554450c5d0eb41a63b91a6200f80a27b19479e06

Fix frontend resource paths to work properly with VHM (#124)

Remove './' prefix from frontend resource and API URLs to ensure compatibility
with Virtual Host Monster (VHM) configurations. This fixes issue #98 where
the admin interface does not honor VHM settings.

The relative paths with './' were causing incorrect URL generation in VHM
environments, particularly with nested path configurations. Using relative
paths without the './' prefix allows the browser to resolve URLs correctly
relative to the current base URL established by VHM.
